title: Slovakian Velvety Fry-Ups
description: A simple and delicious breakfast dish with Slovakian flair. Velvety eggs, stir-fried to a perfect finish.
instructions: Crack 4 eggs into a bowl and whisk until well combined.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and stir constantly until the eggs are almost set.
Add 6 oz of velvety sauce and stir to combine.
Continue cooking for another minute, until the eggs are just set.
